risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides balanced discussion of improved contracts, backlog, margins, losses, pricing pressure, labor shortages, liquidity access, and mortgage-related claims. Risk tone is moderately negative because profitability deteriorated materially and several external and funding risks remain, although management expresses confidence in a housing recovery and future growth. Some forward-looking language and reserve assumptions introduce uncertainty, but the excerpt is not highly evasive.
